Dear [Mr Macmillan](../persons.html#939),
I am sorry to trouble you again, but will you kindly tell me how to answer the letter from [Mrs Blackburn](../persons.html#159) about the Illustrations to the [Little Duke](../books.html#20), which I sent about ten days ago - You see she says it must be settled quickly as she is going abroad
Yours faithfully

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
